page.content:
Common large Morrison theropod, hunter of Jurassic floodplains.

How Allosaurus connects

  • Topic: Theropoda — Allosaurus is the common large theropod of the Morrison.
  • Location: Morrison Formation — Allosaurus is the abundant large theropod of the Morrison Formation.

What is Allosaurus?

Allosaurus is the abundant apex predator of the Morrison Formation, known from Cleveland-Lloyd and Dinosaur National Monument bonebeds.

Key threads lead to Theropoda and Morrison Formation.
